sources.adaptations: Adapted semantic architecture: data-ui-skin-role markers, portable CSS custom properties, dark and light theme palettes, responsive geometry, and accessibility focus rules.

Added React 19 default export. Enforced 44px minimum touch target size. Removed external icon package dependencies in favor of local inline SVG icons. Preserved semantic roles and active press states.
Added React 19 default export. Retained semantic slots for header, title, body, and actions. Maintained data-ui-skin-role markers.
Added React 19 default export. Integrated with focus trap and escape dismissal hooks. Configured overlay backdrop with safe-area spacing.
Added React 19 default export. Implemented progress bar with CSS custom property track and fill clipping. Supports optional label and percent value.
Extracted switch control into dedicated component. Added React 19 default export. Enforced 44px minimum touch targets and accessible switch ARIA roles.
Integrated switch styling and label layout with custom toggle thumb animation.
Added React 19 default export. Wired loading spinner and error retry states with inline SVG icons and action buttons.

Extracted semantic variables for surfaces, text, buttons, panels, progress, and inputs. Added responsive layouts for 390px mobile and 1440px desktop. Added pointer-events pass-through for world canvas.
Adapted focus trap hook for React 19. Retained autofocus preference, tab wrapping, and focus restoration upon unmount.
Adapted escape listener hook for React 19. Triggers dismiss callback on Escape keydown.
Preserved joinClassName utility function for filtering and concatenating class strings.
Incorporated 44px minimum touch target size and responsive phone padding rules into CSS variables.
